correctness.rationale: For 0<t<1 the half-line occupation ODE gives b(s)=1-exp(-s), and the successful origin attempt has density exp(-2u). Conditional on a successful central attempt at u, the two distance-two occupancy indicators are independent Bernoulli random variables with parameter 1-(1-u)exp(u-t). Integrating the complement and its square gives exact conditional two-site and three-site probabilities; their covariance is strictly positive as the variance of a strictly monotone function of the nondegenerate central success time. Direct symbolic integration of both expressions and 166,649 standalone checks support the algebra but do not replace the proof. The saturated gap matrix is a known-pair-correlation consequence only.

originality.rationale: The asserted new claim is ONLY the transient 0<t<1 conditional three-site joint law and its strict covariance sign, not the jammed gap matrix. At saturation the gap matrix is directly implied by previously known correlations at separations two and four, since an occupied pair four sites apart forces the central site occupied at saturation. At intermediate time that implication fails: occupied endpoints can coexist with an unoccupied middle site, so the established two-point data do not determine the conditional three-site statistic. Amaral–dos Santos gives density and all-distance two-point functions; Gerin gives parking density/construction, and Krivelevich et al. density local limits. Evans–Burgess–Hoffman 1984 provides potential higher-order hierarchy coverage; its full text could not be accessed, and independent priority assessment is outstanding.

value.rationale: The conditional time-resolved joint law of the first permitted occupied positions on opposite sides of a successful adsorption event is the lowest-order genuine three-site dependence statistic beyond previously derived one-site and all-distance pair formulas. Its exact strictly positive covariance at every 0<t<1 answers the natural dynamic question whether a shared successful arrival couples initially independent half-lines. The complete two-Bernoulli conditional law and its structural mechanism are the valuable contribution. The saturated gap matrix is not claimed as original.
